name: opencode-sdd-integrity
description: Spec-Driven Development workflow for opencode with phased specs, plans, tasks, approval gates, and verification tooling

scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json npm-shrinkwrap.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version"
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json npm-shrinkwrap.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version"
scripts.version:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json npm-shrinkwrap.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version"
scripts.push: git push origin HEAD && git push origin --tags
scripts.release:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run tag && npm run push
scripts.release:minor: npm run version:minor && npm run tag && npm run push
scripts.release:major: npm run version:major && npm run tag && npm run push
